llm_response.reason: The website presents numerous scam characteristics: promises of guaranteed high and unrealistic returns (up to 80% ROI), urgency and FOMO tactics, vague or missing company information, a recently registered domain with WHOIS privacy masking, exclusive focus on crypto-payment methods, generic and unverifiable testimonials, instant withdrawal promises, and no verifiable business legitimacy or regulatory background. These match the typical features of investment scam websites.
